links.comparator_used: Zero-shot prompting without in-context examples (the baseline that does not natively use informative missingness)
links.outcome: Alignment of verbalized probabilistic beliefs with the target distribution (log-loss) for ICU prognostic inference
links.effect: Reported qualitatively: in-context learning can improve probabilistic alignment; no numbers given in the abstract
links.quote: Using a real-world intensive care testbed, we find that while explicit structural steering and in-context learning can improve probabilistic alignment, the models do not natively leverage informative missingness without careful interventions.
